about.title: About D'Angelo's Pizzeria – Authentic Italian in the Bronx
about.subtitle: Family Tradition Since 1985
about.content:
Welcome to D'Angelo's Pizzeria & Restaurant, your neighborhood Italian restaurant in the Bronx! We serve authentic Italian pizza, fresh pasta, and classic heroes made with love and family recipes passed down through generations.

Our pizzas are made with hand-tossed dough prepared fresh daily, topped with premium mozzarella, San Marzano tomatoes, and the finest ingredients. Whether you're craving a classic Margherita, meat lovers, or our signature D'Angelo's Special, we make it fresh from our brick oven.

We also serve delicious pasta dishes, chicken entrees, fresh salads, calzones, and daily specials. Perfect for family dinners, dine-in, takeout, or delivery in Gun Hill and surrounding areas.

Authentic recipes. Quality ingredients. Family atmosphere. Mangia bene!
